notes: SITE: NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced storefront (COMPID 3572911, siteid 28) with Searchspring (Snap, siteId mrb1uc) driving all facet-browse grids via bgfilter.ss_hierarchy. No Claude-specific robots.txt disallow (checked https://www.westelm.co.uk/robots-we-uk.txt, redirected from /robots.txt). Tier 1 (curl, HTTP) + Tier 2 (Playwright, to capture the client-side Searchspring XHR and its exact bgfilter.ss_hierarchy value plus pagination.totalResults) were sufficient; Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. CHECKED: main mega-nav (Ideas & Inspiration menu links 'All Best Sellers' + quick filters Furniture/Sofas & Armchairs/Rugs/Lighting), footer, and the site's own inspiration/trending hub. FOUND: exactly one genuine Bestsellers PLP concept, exposed via two URLs that resolve to the IDENTICAL Searchspring listing: /ideas-inspiration/best-selling-styles (ss_hierarchy='Inspirations>Shop Best Sellers', self-canonical) and /ideas-inspiration/best-selling-styles/shop-more-best-sellers (ss_hierarchy='Inspirations>Shop Best Sellers>Shop All Best Sellers', self-canonical). Both API calls returned pagination.totalResults=614 and, verified directly, the SAME 70 product ids in the SAME order on page 1 (per-page fetch comparison) - proven to be one underlying listing exposed at two navigation depths, not two different listings. Kept the canonical top-level URL (best-selling-styles, the one linked as 'All Best Sellers' in the mega-nav); the shop-more-best-sellers URL is the verified duplicate and was dropped rather than emitted as a second row. QTY: every Searchspring category.json response for this site injects exactly 2 non-product marketing banners (data-banner-type='image', e.g. an Autumn Sale banner and a PayPal banner) into merchandising.content.inline, which are double-counted inside pagination.totalResults; verified directly on the single-page New Furniture listing where totalResults=68 but the actual results array held 66 real product entries (68-2=66, exact match), and re-verified the 2-banner injection is a one-time (not per-page) event by pulling page 2 of a multi-page listing and finding 0 banners / 72 full real results there. Applied the same totalResults-2 correction here: 614-2=612. EXCLUDED (checked, not genuine separate PLPs): the mega-nav's 'Furniture Best Sellers' / 'Sofas & Armchairs' / 'Rugs' / 'Lighting' quick links are all client-side hash-fragment facet filters (#/filter:supercategoryname:... or #/filter:primary_category:...) applied to the SAME shop-more-best-sellers listing and the SAME ss_hierarchy - they are not distinct hierarchy nodes and have no own canonical URL, so they were treated as arbitrary filter cuts per the brief, not recorded as separate rows (spot-checked the Furniture cut via filter.supercategoryname=Furniture: 173 products, confirming they are real facet slices of the one listing, not new listings). Also checked /ideas-inspiration/shop-trending-styles ('Trending Now') - confirmed this is CMS_HTML editorial/lookbook content (mid-century, small-space, Christmas-lookbook sub-pages), not a Searchspring facet-browse product grid, so excluded as editorial per the brief's Trending-Products guidance.

rows.evidence: Searchspring category.json bgfilter.ss_hierarchy='Inspirations>Shop Best Sellers' pagination.totalResults=614; merchandising.content.inline=2 non-product promo banners (verified data-banner-type='image', not products); qty = 614 - 2 = 612. Duplicate listing at /ideas-inspiration/best-selling-styles/shop-more-best-sellers (ss_hierarchy='Inspirations>Shop Best Sellers>Shop All Best Sellers') returned the identical totalResults=614 and identical 70-item first-page product id set/order - confirmed same listing, not merged as a second row.
